intro: The eggplant emoji 🍆 has two lives: it is the literal aubergine you cook with, and it is also long-standing internet slang, widely used as an innuendo for male anatomy. This page covers both plainly — the vegetable and its reputation — then gathers the other fruits and vegetables that picked up similar double meanings online (🍑 peach, 🌽 corn, 🥒 cucumber, 🍌 banana), the plates and pans for eggplant's everyday culinary use, and food kaomoji for when you're just hungry. Grab a single glyph, or copy a ready-made produce combo set.
